name: Button
structurePatterns: horizontal flex with 8px gap; label single-line; centered content
full-width in mobile forms (.block modifier stretches to 100%)
icon-only buttons keep square hit area ≥ size-control-height
usageHints: Primary is a scarce hierarchy signal: normally one highest-priority primary action per view or action group
Do not promote every available action to Primary; use Secondary for visible supporting actions and Tertiary for low-emphasis actions
When Primary and supporting actions appear together, avoid multiple brand-filled buttons competing in the same visual region
Secondary uses a neutral surface by default so action importance is not confused with brand-color area
Destructive is reserved for irreversible actions and does not compete with Primary unless destruction is the current confirmed task
Visual height differs from platform hit target (iOS 44 / Android 48)
doNotInvent: no gradient or glow on primary (flat-first)
no repeated primary-filled treatment merely because several actions are clickable
unknowns: exact loading-spinner-in-button spacing not specified in RC2
